name: Γράμματα
live.title: Played part
live.name: Part {d}
live.listenMidi: Play a MIDI keyboard or an instrument alongside
live.metroFtr: A count-in first; notes land on the metronome beats.
live.freeFtr: Without a metronome, tempo and bars are found from the playing after stop.
live.strFtr: On the staff, notes always sit on the grid. Strength sets how close the MIDI file is pulled to the grid: lower is looser.
live.noFret: This note is not on that string
live.barsPick: Tap the first bar, then the last
live.restHint: Rest — a note can go here
live.exportFtr: The part is already saved in Tabs; this exports a file for other apps or the studio.
live.emptyMic: ● records from the microphone: one melody; notes and tabs appear while playing.
live.emptyMidi: ● records from a MIDI keyboard or an app instrument in a neighbouring session window.
